title: Kissed Roasted Venezuelan Chicken Thighs Roast
description: Earthy and juicy Venezuelan dish featuring chicken thighs, perfect for a lacto-vegetarian friendly meal, roasted to perfection on a binchotan grill.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, garlic, oregano, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken thighs to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and place on the preheated grill.
Roast the chicken for 25-30 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the chicken is cooking, mix the yogurt with a pinch of salt and set aside.
Once the chicken is cooked, brush with the yogurt mixture and return to the grill for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the grill and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
